package.name: katana_tutorials
package.description:
ROS 2 tutorial and demo programs for the Neuronics Katana 450 arm.
Tutorials 1-3 use the rclcpp_action / FollowJointTrajectory interface (they require ros2_control + katana_driver to be running).
Tutorials 4-5 use the KNI SDK directly via a TCP connection and run independently of any ROS 2 stack — useful for low-level diagnostics.
